_about: What a board needs to play in the phone app's local webview (tools/phone-board.mjs ships exactly this, mirrored under the skill's own paths — a game's `new URL('../../worlds/…', import.meta.url)` keeps working untouched). `entry` pages: the host page (scripts/games/phone/). `games.<id>`: the game's module, its own folder (bundle, engine, art, font), the shared files it names by URL, and the JS it loads through its static imports (found by walking them — never listed). `exclude`: build leftovers inside a game folder. `dynamic`: modules a game loads on demand that the phone does not ship yet (the camera 结印).
